| description = Grizzleknot wanders from (-535, -315), (1245, -1830), and (-1700, -1300). Centaurs might be the placeholders, but not confirmed.

edit 14/05/2020 : after reading up and camping him, here is the way i did it to spawn Grizzle twice in 4 hours total, on 2 different mornings. Make a triangle between centaur village, undead pyramid and the bard's well and kill everything roamers in line of sight (even if it is not right in the zone and a bit outside of it). Each time, Grizzleknot spawned on the NW side of the well.
Grizzle spawned right after i killed Coloth Meadowgreen twice in 2 mins (back to back spawn), dont know if there is a connection but worth noting.

On 03/20/2021 I spawned Grizzleknot at loc -535, -315. Placeholder is centaur foal (always) on 32 min timer. PH will roam so kill all centaur foals in area around centaur village, bard well and undead pyramid and monitor spawn loc. Took me about 10-12 PHs. -Garku on Green server
